checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: The final deliverable is one square poster.
All lettering is black and clearly readable against the chosen background.
must.why: Black text on mustard, high contrast.

must.item: There are no pictures, illustrations or additional words.
must.why: Only the three lines on a flat background.

faults.what: Plain, minimal design with tight spacing between lines and lots of empty space; low resolution (640px). The mustard shade is slightly darker than the stated #F2C14E.

summary: The final square poster has all three lines spelled exactly, in black on mustard with no pictures; it is plain but clean and readable.
